Auli weekend from Delhi

Day 0 - Leave from Delhi by 09:00 PM (Friday). Overnight bus, stop at Devprayag on the way.
Day 1-2 - Reach Joshimath, check in. Day trip to Auli by road or ropeway. Skiing and snow meadows, optional snow trek to Gorson Bugyal depending on conditions. Overnight stay in Joshimath.
Day 3 - Check out from hotel. Visit Narsingh Temple. Leave for Delhi. Halt at Rishikesh for dinner. Reach Delhi early next morning.
note: Day 0 is the overnight departure evening, so it counts as a date. Day 1-2 is a range line to test grouping. Source page was unreachable (502) on fetch; text assembled from the operator's listing as shown in search results.
